name: ludic-canvas
description: React interfaces for browser games, powered by Yoga WebAssembly and WebGL.
author: Victor Queiroz

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run docs:generate && vite --config vite.docs.config.ts
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && npm run docs:generate && vite build --config vite.docs.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run docs:build && npm run audit:public && npm run test:package
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests tools cli examples .changeset "docs/*.md" docs/main.tsx docs/enhance.ts docs/style.css docs/performance docs/components/main.tsx docs/components/style.css docs/play/main.tsx docs/play/game.css docs/play/gallery.ts docs/play/gallery.css docs/3d/main.ts docs/3d/scene.css *.json *.ts *.md .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests tools cli examples .changeset "docs/*.md" docs/main.tsx docs/enhance.ts docs/style.css docs/performance docs/components/main.tsx docs/components/style.css docs/play/main.tsx docs/play/game.css docs/play/gallery.ts docs/play/gallery.css docs/3d/main.ts docs/3d/scene.css *.json *.ts *.md .github
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run build && npm run docs:generate
scripts.fonts:game: node cli/index.mjs fonts --config examples/orbital-relay/ui/ludic-canvas.fonts.json && node cli/index.mjs fonts --config examples/orbital-relay/missions/ludic-canvas.fonts.json
